empirical_requirements.C: measured clock, latency and synchronisation characterisation
empirical_requirements.D: empirical signal-integrity study with real fault occurrences
empirical_requirements.E: method comparison on measured data with accepted sensitivity bounds
empirical_requirements.F: device-specific reconstruction checked against a criterion measure
empirical_requirements.G: protocol event detection checked against adjudicated events
empirical_requirements.H: metric-definition review against the protocol literature by a domain expert
empirical_requirements.J: criterion measure or independent instrument for the physical quantity
empirical_requirements.L: paired measured cross-device agreement study (at least 20 independent subjects)
empirical_requirements.M: provenance of measured data back to the acquisition session
empirical_requirements.O: limitation statement reviewed by a domain expert

required_computational.B: declared calibration and geometry records are typed, applied by processing, and missing or contradictory records are refused
required_computational.O: limitation statements are sourced and emitted with every result

blockers: B: declared calibration and geometry records are typed, applied by processing, and missing or contradictory records are refused (owner RES-698; rated specified)
J: an independent reference implementation or closed form that shares no code with the engine (owner RES-669; rated partial)
O: limitation statements are sourced and emitted with every result (owner RES-698; rated partial)
empirical_gaps: Gate geometry, trigger validity and timing-error bounds need empirical metrology (RES-694)
Sprint assessment variants and cross-device agreement remain open (RES-673/703)
